house.description: Dakota County regional household hazardous waste and recycling facility funding provided, bonds issued, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Capital Investment

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a regional household hazardous waste and recycling facility in Dakota County; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+DAKOTA-SCOTT COUNTIES; HOUSEHOLD HAZARDOUS WASTE AND RECYCLING FACILITY. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

[+$8,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the Pollution Control Agency for a grant under the solid waste capital assistance grant program in Minnesota Statutes, section 115A.54, to the joint powers entity established under Minnesota Statutes, section 471.59, subdivision 1, between Dakota and Scott Counties, to construct and equip a new regional facility to process household hazardous waste and recycling for Dakota and Scott Counties. The facility will be located in Dakota County at a site that best supports access needs for residents and businesses from both Dakota and Scott Counties. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Bond sale.+]

[+To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $8,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a regional household hazardous waste and recycling facility in Dakota County; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. DAKOTA-SCOTT COUNTIES; HOUSEHOLD HAZARDOUS WASTE AND RECYCLING FACILITY.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

$8,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the Pollution Control Agency for a grant under the solid waste capital assistance grant program in Minnesota Statutes, section 115A.54, to the joint powers entity established under Minnesota Statutes, section 471.59, subdivision 1, between Dakota and Scott Counties, to construct and equip a new regional facility to process household hazardous waste and recycling for Dakota and Scott Counties. The facility will be located in Dakota County at a site that best supports access needs for residents and businesses from both Dakota and Scott Counties.

Subd. 2.

Bond sale.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $8,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

The facility will be located in Dakota County at a site that best supports access needs for residents and businesses from both Dakota and Scott Counties.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $8,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
